purpose: Close the zero-hold grain/time reduction contract before inserting shared storage. Paths are available, but a warehouse split must not create food through multiplied retention or add an automatic accounting bin. This is an isolated engineering control, not a warehouse scenario or historical validation.
inputs: Use qualified original route certificates and the two ORIGINAL central/low monthly baseline archives only. Preserve all old sources, paths, owners, fixed populations, dispatch, whole-leg retention and one-bin endpoint arrivals. No graph rebuild, Dijkstra, new route/port search, weather or crop computation, food/stock solve or parameter sweep.
primitive: Represent each funded whole-leg movement once by a unique consignment ID, original physical endpoints, sent amount, already-declared whole-leg delivered amount/charge and original endpoint arrival bin. Optional ordered intermediate events describe that same consignment. Intermediate events cannot become extra funded shipments or independently multiply retention. Any allocation of the whole-leg charge must be explicit, nonnegative and sum to the existing charge; do not derive new physical travel times from cost. Keep whole-leg endpoint delivery as the exact authoritative value, including its original rounding. Zero hold preserves original arrival bin, including year wrap, without a new default-bin leg. Duplicate consignment funding, invalid IDs, negative/nonfinite or overdrawn amounts, unsupported hold/capacity/rights inferences must fail.
manufactured_controls: Declare a small finite set before execution covering zero/full/partial whole-leg loss, two or more intermediate events, zero funded grain, duplicate-funding rejection, changed intermediate partition with identical endpoint charge, December-to-January wrap and a counterexample to multiplying subleg retention. Verify whole-grain conservation and unchanged endpoint timing independently at existing tolerances. This primitive must expose the conservation obligation rather than claim physical calibration of intermediate losses.
legacy_reductions: After manufactured controls, perform EXACTLY two no-hold accounting replays, one original central and one original low monthly baseline. Replay recorded departures/owner/retention and recorded intertown shipments only; require exact original direct and intertown endpoint arrival arrays using original operation ordering and rounding. Do not solve rural, export, direct or town inventories again, change quotas or create new grain movements. These are identity controls, zero new Earth food scenarios. Any mismatch is retained and blocks warehouse attachment; no tolerance relaxation or tuning.
limits_and_next_gate: No actual warehouse is selected, mapped or assigned capacity/rights/work. The ledger's optional intermediate event is not evidence of a granary or authenticated historical port. Positive hold, withdrawal scheduling, shared commercial/town capacity deduplication, handling/transport work and physical access remain separate declarations after this no-hold contract passes. Buringh size/climate l and site-survey workbook stay unopened; climate/steppe deferred; no fit, demographic iteration or atlas/default adoption.
